title: First vertical slice: auditable ECDLP toy research lifecycle
question: Can the shared laboratory execute and persist a small honest research lifecycle from independent candidate generation through falsification, blind review and an exact Lean proof obligation?
rationale: Immediate first vertical slice required by the full laboratory mission; implementation precedes broad research.
next_action: Start at docs/CLAUDE_START.md, create a RUN and remote task claim, then implement the first vertical slice. Subsequent phases remain in docs/LAB_MISSION.md.
notes: Draft only; no execution or verification claimed.
success_criteria: Read and preserve existing work; implement shared extended schemas/lifecycle and durable SQLite memory with append-only versioned events.
Register distinct exact, speculative toy hypotheses without sharing preliminary conclusions; search prior hypotheses/failures before new work.
Execute a reproducible counterexample attempt and persist observed command/exit/output evidence; retain failures.
Create a neutral blind-review packet; record actual independent reviewer identity/model when available, or blocked status when unavailable.
Formalize the smallest useful exact statement in Lean 4/Mathlib; record proof obligations, real compiler feedback and theorem correspondence without weakening.
Persist result, evidence hashes, task checkpoints and next actions; keep correctness/complexity/experiment/review states separate.
Run relevant tests and ledger validation; commit verified progress on codex/ecdlp-research-laboratory. Do not claim both-provider live integration unless actually executed.
owned_files: Dedicated Git worktrees or exclusive file ownership assigned by Claude PI; preserve existing ledger.
resource_limit: Begin with two bounded independent discovery contexts only if native spawning and quota permit. Otherwise prepare isolated sealed submissions sequentially and explicitly mark independence unestablished. No recursive spawning; define token/time/process limits before launch.
